name: Muramite Citadel: Upper Prison
summary: A high‑security detention level where elite Dragorn captives and arcane subjects are held under Discord wards.
description: The Upper Prison is the most secure detention layer of the Muramite Citadel. Reinforced cells, Discord‑warded containment chambers, and elite jailer stations dominate the area. Dangerous captives, arcane subjects, and resistance infiltrators are held here under constant surveillance. The air hums with Discord resonance, and the stone walls pulse with ward energy. Muramite Inquisitors oversee containment protocols while elite jailers enforce brutal discipline.
